content.comment_body: The instructions apply to all versions of [product_name] Pure ([version_no] or newer). Firmware updates are not available for older [product_name] devices. Procedure: Turn on the device's power supply while a Micro SD card containing only the firmware update is inserted. The LED on the front flashes during the update process. Once the update is complete, the LED remains continuously lit (the color can vary depending on whether a user program is present). Firmware updates can be accessed using these links: [url] (for [version_no]), [url] ([version_no]), and [url] ([version_no]). Note: Software is subject to export restrictions and may require registration first. Please check ‘Access authorization for downloading export restricted software’ at [url]. [company_name] Support.

There are updated firmware versions for [product_name] devices numbered [version_no] and [version_no] released on July 7th, 2020, which resolve security concerns. Product details reference a firmware update addressing the security vulnerability CVE-2020-7593.
